## 3dslibris 2.7.5

Hotfix update focused on EPUB block/image layout consistency and spacing behavior in real-book scenarios.

### Bug Fixes

* #77: fixed random blank space at the top of the right screen (second reading screen) when paragraph text overflows from the left screen — the mandatory block-break linefeed is now skipped if the screen has not yet rendered any visible content.
* #128: fixed block-display image/page-pushing discrepancies where some EPUB images could be misclassified and forced into page-like behavior after metadata probing failures.
